page.title: Feso'ota'i
page.intro: Fa'afeso'ota'i au tala fa'asalalauga. O ta'ita'i mai au fa'asalalauga e otometi lava ona taunu'u i My Leads, fa'atasi ai ma tupe fa'aalu ma tau ile ta'ita'i.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form e taʻitaʻia i Oʻu Taʻitaʻi, tupe faʻaalu i aso taʻitasi ma le tau i le taʻitaʻi, ma le taʻitaʻi lelei e toe lafoina i LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: E le'i fa'atulagaina i luga o lenei 'au'aunaga

banner.connected: LinkedIn feso'ota'i. O lo'o aumai nei ta'ita'i - e toe fa'afou lenei itulau i se taimi vave.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn e le'i fa'atulagaina i luga o lenei 'au'aunaga. E tatau i le pule ona fa'aopoopo le ID ma le mealilo a le tagata fa'aoga LinkedIn .
banner.expired: Ua uma le feso'ota'iga LinkedIn , o lea e le'o fa'atasi ai ta'ita'i. Toe fa'afeso'ota'i e fa'aauau.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn e mana'omia oe e toe saini ile {{date}} . Toe fa'afeso'ota'i a'o le'i o'o i le taimi lena ina ia fa'asolo pea ta'ita'i.

connect.title: Fa'afeso'ota'i LinkedIn
connect.intro: Saini i totonu ma le LinkedIn account e pulea au faʻasalalauga. Leadrat e faitau na'o au fa'amatalaga fa'asalalauga, ta'ita'i Lead Gen Form ma fa'amaumauga fa'asalalauga, ma lafo atu suiga e te fa'aola.
connect.need1: O se matafaioi i luga o le LinkedIn ad account (Vaaiga pe sili atu).
connect.need2: O se matafaioi i luga o le itulau kamupani fesoʻotaʻi (Pule, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator or Analyst) - LinkedIn e manaʻomia e faʻasoa taʻitaʻia.
connect.need3: Ole fesili ile numera ole telefoni ile Lead Gen Forms - ta'ita'i e aunoa ma se numera telefoni e le mafai ona fa'aopoopo.

connection.title: So'oga
connection.autoRenews: Fa'afou fa'afou otometi se'ia o'o i lena taimi

connection.confirmDisconnect: motusia LinkedIn ? Fa'ato'a tu'u fa'atasi ma tape 'ese'ese fa'ailoga avanoa. O ta'ita'i, fa'amaumauga ma le fa'amaumauga o gaioiga o lo'o teuina.
connection.noPermission: E mafai ona e va'ai i lenei itulau. Feso'ota'i ma suia tulaga e mana'omia le fa'atagaga "Manage Settings".
connection.fetchTitle: Aumai ta'ita'i ile va o aso
connection.fetchHint: O ta'ita'i fou e siaki i nai minute uma ma aso 7 mulimuli e toe siaki i aso uma, o lea e leai se mea e misi. Fa'aoga le mea lea mo ta'ita'i a'o le'i fa'afeso'ota'i, pe toe siaki se vaitaimi (e o'o i le 90 aso i le taimi). O ta'ita'i ua uma ona iai i Leadrat ua misi.

accounts.none: Leai ni tala fa'asalalauga na maua mo lenei fa'amatalaga LinkedIn . Siaki le matafaioi a le teugatupe i LinkedIn Campaign Manager , ona toe faafou.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Ta'u LinkedIn po'o fea o ana ta'ita'i na avea ma fa'amoemoega moni. A oʻo atu se taʻitaʻi LinkedIn i se tulaga e te filifilia i lalo, Leadrat lipoti atu i LinkedIn , o lea o au lipoti faʻasalalauga e faʻaalia ai le tulaga lelei ma LinkedIn e mafai ona maua ai le tele o tagata e pei o au taʻitaʻi sili. E na'o le LinkedIn ta'ita'i ID ma se tasi-ala hash o le imeli e lafo.
capi.noRules: E leai ni tulaga o fa'afanua.
capi.created: Fa'aliliuga na faia ile LinkedIn ma fa'afanua.

activity.title: Fa'amaumauga o gaioiga
activity.intro: Mea uma i le va o Leadrat ma LinkedIn : fesoʻotaʻiga, faʻatasi uma, taʻiala uma ma mea na tupu i ai, liua ma mea sese.
activity.empty: Leai se gaioiga i le taimi nei.
